en: Yue Buqun: You must be Lv 10 or higher to join the Huashan Sect.
Yue Buqun: Huashan is a sect of gentlemen and of chivalry. Would you like to join?
Joined the Huashan Sect
Yue Buqun: Huashan is a sect of gentlemen and of chivalry. Never do anything unseemly, and never take a taste for killing.

Yue Buqun: Huashan was once split into the Sword and Qi Schools, and our forebears slaughtered one another over it. The Sword School started it all. Now I hear their elder Feng Qingyang still lives. Look into it for me.
Yes, Master.
Yue Buqun: Well? Is it true?
I just came back from the inn in the Capital. The innkeeper says people have seen an old man and two disciples flying about Mt. Hua. How come I've never seen them?
Yue Buqun: The back mountain, perhaps?
Yue Buqun: There is a room in our sect with a secret passage to the cave on Repentance Cliff. Here is the key to its door. Go and see whether anyone else has been there.
Yue Buqun: Come here, my disciple. Your master has something important for you.
What is it?
Yue Buqun: Lately Lao Denuo has not seemed quite right to me. He is in Yangzhou on sect business; keep a quiet eye on him. And remember: not a word of this to anyone!
Master, you were right. Something is wrong with Lao Denuo.
Yue Buqun: Say no more. I know everything.
Master, how...?
Yue Buqun: Someone swapped my Violet Mist Manual for a fake, and Lao Denuo's carrier pigeon is overdue. I guessed it was him. Curse him!
Master, I saw him in Yangzhou with men from the Songshan Sect.
Yue Buqun: What? Are you sure of what you saw?
I'm sure. I saw them.
Yue Buqun: Zuo Lengchan! You treacherous snake!
Yue Buqun: Go to Yangzhou at once, find Lao Denuo and get the real Violet Mist Manual back. I am going to settle accounts with Zuo Lengchan!
Master, you're back already?
Yue Buqun: The old fox denies everything. Did you bring Lao Denuo back? I want him to face Zuo in person and see what he has to say!
When I got there they had already silenced him. They shot him dead with a hidden arrow.
Yue Buqun: What? Those villains! And the Violet Mist Manual?
I think stealing the manual was Lao Denuo's own idea. They didn't know about it and just killed him to shut him up, so the Violet Mist Manual was still on him.
Yue Buqun: Hm. Yes, this is the real Violet Mist Manual. You have done the sect a great service. I shall teach you some of the Violet Mist art.
Liang Fa: Master lives by righteousness and chivalry, a true gentleman. That is why the whole martial world respects him.
Liang Fa: Our scouts report that bandits of unknown origin have been raiding homes in the Heartland, and the people are crying out. Will you find their lair and wipe them out?
Liang Fa: Huashan and the common folk stand or fall together. Remember: never use your martial arts to bully ordinary people. Understood?
Understood!
Liang Fa: Well done. Now I shall teach you the Huashan Swordplay. Use it wisely.
Lu Dayou: Monkeys really are adorable.
Lu Dayou: Oh dear, what am I going to do?
What's wrong?
Ignore
Brother Lu, is something bothering you?
Lu Dayou: I accidentally tore the Tiger Kasaya - the robe the Tiger-Taming Fist is written on. If Master finds out, he'll punish me for sure. What am I going to do?
Could you patch it with a tiger skin?
Lu Dayou: Of course! Will you find me a Tiger Skin? They say there are lots of tigers in Flower Vale.
I will
I won't
Brother Lu, I found you a Tiger Skin. Will this do?
Lu Dayou: Yes, yes, yes, that's perfect! Now Master won't punish me. I've been practising the Tiger-Taming Fist for ages - let me teach you a bit. Just don't tell Master!
Thank you, Brother Lu!
Sister looks so gloomy. She keeps muttering about a sword.
Lu Dayou: Of course she does. That was Little Sister's favourite sword, and not long ago it fell into the Mt. Hua valley.
Can it be found, Sixth Brother? I'll go and look for it for Sister.
Lu Dayou: All I know is it fell down the mountain. And the valley is full of big apes - it's very dangerous. I'd rather you didn't go.
It's all right. I'll take a look, and if I can't find it I'll just come back.
Lu Dayou: Off you go, then! But... if you do find the sword, you'd better take it to Big Brother, all right?
Ying Bailuo: Mt. Hua's hills and streams are a delight to the eye.
You look troubled. Is something the matter?

Ying Bailuo: A disciple of mine was bitten by a deadly red-banded snake by the lake. I forced out the venom with my internal energy, but it had reached his heart. His life is saved, but his martial skill... Sigh! Such a waste.
Is there no other way to clear out the venom?

Ying Bailuo: The venom of the red-banded snake is no ordinary poison. They say only the Dragon Dew newly made by the killer physician Ping Yizhi can cure it. But he is of the Demon Cult, and that puts me in a real bind.
This is the antidote I got from Ping Yizhi. Take it and try.
Ying Bailuo: Wonderful! He can be saved! For such a great favour, I'll teach you the Primordial Palm.

Ying Bailuo: Lord Yue Fei held back the Jin soldiers in his day. What a hero! Alas, traitors at court had him killed. Now the border is in peril, and they say Yue Fei's Sword still exists. Find it and take it straight to the palace in the Capital.
Ying Bailuo: Have you found Yue Fei's Sword?
Not only did I find it, I handed it to His Majesty myself.
Ying Bailuo: Good, very good. Then the Stone-Splitting Jade-Breaking Fist is yours.
Feng Qingyang: The Sword School's arts are the true martial arts of Huashan.
Feng Qingyang: Who are you? What are you doing here?
I am a disciple of the Huashan Sect. How did you get into this secret cave of Huashan? Are you from the Sword School?
Feng Qingyang: Indeed. So you know there is such a thing as the Sword School.
Hmph! Your side started the killing back then and sent the founders of Huashan to their graves one by one. Must sword and qi really fight to see which is better?
Feng Qingyang: What? We started the killing? That brat Yue Buqun has taught you lies.
Don't you speak ill of my master!
Feng Qingyang: Hmph. Your master is nothing but a hypocrite!
Yue Buqun: You Sword School people never have a good word for us of the Qi School!
Feng Qingyang: Hmph, so you've come at last. Let your disciple hear the truth of what happened!
Yue Buqun: You...! Curse you!

Feng Qingyang: Back then your Qi School claimed that qi commands the sword - qi is the root, the sword only the branch - and set out to drive the Sword School out of Huashan. Did you ever tell your disciple that?
Master, is this true?
Yue Buqun: This...! You...! Curse you! Hmph!
Master?! So it is true?
Feng Qingyang: Now you know the truth!
Yue Buqun: Very well, I'll speak plainly. Join forces with me to get rid of these three, and I'll make you senior disciple of the Qi School and teach you the Violet Mist art!
Join forces
Refuse
Very well, it's a deal!
Sword School destroyed
Now senior Qi School disciple
Hmph! So this is your true face at last. Grand-uncle Feng, I'm with you!
Yue Buqun: You little...! Very well! Very well! Then I'll just have to get rid of you all together.
Yue Buqun defeated
Yue Buqun fled in panic.
Feng Qingyang: So you can tell right from wrong after all. You have an honest heart, so I'll break with custom and take you as a Sword School disciple.
Feng Qingyang: From now on, if you need anything, come straight to me. As of today I am your master.
Cheng Buyou: I am a Sword School disciple. I have lived here in seclusion all these years, practising our school's swordplay.
Feng Buping: I am a Sword School disciple. I have lived here in seclusion all these years, practising our school's swordplay.
Brother Cheng, your swordplay is superb. Could you teach me?

Cheng Buyou: This is the Deadly Linked Three Immortals Sword - Fatal Trio for short. This swordplay needs a first-rate sword, and I have none to spare. Go and buy one at the weapon shop, and then I'll teach you.
Brother Cheng, how about this sword?
Cheng Buyou: Hm, that will do. Only a fine sword like this can stand up to the training; anything less breaks easily.
Cheng Buyou: Watch closely as I go through the moves.
Cheng Buyou: This sword is too poor - it would snap after one session. Go and find a better one.
Cheng Buyou: The Fatal Trio is the very essence of swordplay in the martial arts. Keep reflecting on it and you will understand.
Feng Qingyang: What is it?
Big Brother asked me to give you this letter.
Feng Qingyang: A letter? Let me read it......
Feng Qingyang: So Chong'er wrote this letter. He asks me to pass my martial arts on to you.
Your martial arts? Big Brother? Chong'er? I don't understand.
Feng Qingyang: You need not understand. You have good aptitude, it seems.
Feng Qingyang: Tell me: which matters more, qi or the sword? Which is the root, and which the branch?
Sword and qi both matter. There's no need to rank them.
Feng Qingyang: That answer will do. Once you have mastered the Nine Swords of Dugu that I teach you, you will understand.
